title: Publicar atómicamente el fix owner-level de V11 servido
mission: Repair the existing V11 source-to-served loop so a main change under current-tree/control-v11 cannot trigger served Chromium verification against stale Pages bytes. Publish the already-present routeResolved hydration repair through the existing V11 CANDIDATE publication owner without force-updating gh-pages, prove served-byte identity changed to the intended source, then run the existing served Chromium harness.

critic_diagnosis.root_cause: Both .github/workflows/mp10-v11-served-browser-ci-v1.yml and .github/workflows/mp10-v11-served-job-ci-v1.yml trigger on current-tree/control-v11/** but verify the public GitHub Pages route without any preceding publication/served-byte identity gate. Therefore a main source repair can deterministically race a stale served candidate.
critic_diagnosis.minimal_repair: Reuse the existing publication owner/path and make publication or explicit served-byte identity a prerequisite of the served browser gate; do not add a parallel publisher and do not force-update gh-pages.

definition_of_done: Confirm the main owner-level routeResolved repair remains the intended source bytes before publication.
Identify and reuse the existing V11 CANDIDATE publication owner/path; do not create a parallel publisher.
Make publication completion or explicit served-byte identity a prerequisite for served Chromium verification after current-tree/control-v11 source changes.
Update the V11 CANDIDATE served surface without force-updating gh-pages and verify served v11.js bytes correspond to the repaired owner-level source.

Rerun the existing served Chromium harness against those changed served bytes and record reload/back/forward plus later narrow-layout/static-preview/project-context/stats outcomes before any promotion claim.

semantic_identity.target: v11 candidate served owner-level routeResolved repair publication
acceptance: main owner-level v11.js routeResolved repair is atomically published to the existing V11 CANDIDATE served surface without force-updating gh-pages
